says: In next/, slice 13 of the Reflect ban adds test helpers (read, named and watcher in next/apps/fabrika/e2e/client-protocol.test-support.ts:287-295, said in next/apps/fabrika/e2e/p14.test-support.ts:680) with no ## Existing tools line in docs/plan/quests/reflect-ban-PLAN.md, which 0587 asks for each new helper, including one in an existing file; this is the second time in this plan after slice 14 (field/findings/2026-11-16-reflect-ban-s14-helpers-no-existing-tools-line.json), and the cause is that the plan has no such section and plancheck.sh only asks for a line for a new code file in the files table, so a helper inside an existing file is never asked for in an amendment.
proof: grep -c '## Existing tools' docs/plan/quests/reflect-ban-PLAN.md prints 0 at 2f87d96ca; read (client-protocol.test-support.ts:287) and said (p14.test-support.ts:680) are the same shape, Option.getOrElse(Schema.decodeUnknownOption(S)(value), () => ({})), written in two files.
cost: The search for an existing helper is not on record for any helper this plan added, and each later amendment can add more without one.
